description: Source code for the Sales Order doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, validation, creation of related documents, and various utility functions for sales order processing.

classes.name: WarehouseRequired
classes.description: Custom validation error class for missing warehouse on stock items.

classes.name: SalesOrder
classes.description: Main class representing a Sales Order, with methods for validation, submission, cancellation, status updates, and related operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the sales order before submission.

methods.name: validate_po
methods.description: Validates purchase order date vs delivery date and duplicate PO against customer.

methods.name: validate_for_items
methods.description: Validates item availability and projected quantities.

methods.name: product_bundle_has_stock_item
methods.description: Checks if a product bundle contains stock items.

methods.name: validate_sales_mntc_quotation
methods.description: Validates related quotation's order type.

methods.name: validate_delivery_date
methods.description: Ensures delivery date is after sales order date and sets maximum delivery date.

methods.name: validate_proj_cust
methods.description: Validates that the customer belongs to the specified project.

methods.name: validate_warehouse
methods.description: Validates warehouse assignment for stock items.

methods.name: validate_with_previous_doc
methods.description: Validates linkage with previous documents like quotation.

methods.name: update_enquiry_status
methods.description: Updates the status of related opportunity based on quotation.

methods.name: update_prevdoc_status
methods.description: Updates the status of linked quotation documents.

methods.name: validate_drop_ship
methods.description: Ensures drop-shipped items have a supplier set.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Operations performed when sales order is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Operations performed when sales order is canceled.

methods.name: update_project
methods.description: Updates project sales amount if configured.

methods.name: check_credit_limit
methods.description: Checks customer's credit limit before order approval.

methods.name: check_nextdoc_docstatus
methods.description: Ensures linked invoices are deleted before cancel.

methods.name: check_modified_date
methods.description: Prevents updates if the document has been modified externally.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the sales order.

methods.name: update_reserved_qty
methods.description: Updates reserved quantities in stock bins.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Placeholder for actions on update.

methods.name: before_update_after_submit
methods.description: Validates data after submission before update.

methods.name: validate_supplier_after_submit
methods.description: Ensures supplier consistency after submit if PO exists.

methods.name: update_delivery_status
methods.description: Updates delivery status based on purchase orders.

methods.name: set_indicator
methods.description: Sets portal indicator based on billing/delivery status.

methods.name: get_work_order_items
methods.description: Returns items for work order creation, excluding those with linked BOM.

methods.name: on_recurring
methods.description: Handles recurring sales orders, adjusting delivery dates.
